text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер has received a fan letter
and one
thousand origami cranes, which
I give to her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I mean, seriously, this fan made a
thousand
origami cranes for a side
character like me...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
One thousand. Can you imagine how
long it
must've taken?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
That's just how dedicated they are to
supporting you.

text_block_list.text:
...I know. And it's not like I don't
appreciate it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess it's time to head to
training!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
She carefully arranges the origami cranes
on the
window and we head off to
training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
